headline: Rand Mutual Assurance Faces Misconduct Probe Over R32 Billion Asset Manager Mandate
summary: Rand Mutual Assurance has been shaken by misconduct allegations surrounding the appointment of an asset manager for a 32 billion rand mandate, amid claims by whistleblowers that board members attempted to bury an independent report.
why: Rand Mutual Assurance manages substantial insurance and disability funds for South Africa's mining and metals sector, drawing regulatory scrutiny over fiduciary stewardship.

impacts.name: Financial Services
impacts.why: Governance allegations can result in regulatory sanctions and reviews of delegated investment management contracts.
